blurb: Guests can enjoy a 90-minute architectural river cruise with expert volunteer docents narrating Chicago's architecture. The fleet offers open-air upper decks and climate-controlled salons with full-service bars. Private events and weddings are hosted on various vessels accommodating 2 to 200 guests with customizable options and city skyline views.
